output.why: The evidence clearly points to an availability issue caused by the deployment being scaled down to zero replicas. The k8s_state shows "desired replicas: 0/0" and "effective endpoints ready/not-ready: 0/1", along with pod deletion events. Despite this, metrics show the service was recently handling traffic normally (16.9 rps, 0% error rate, healthy latency), and logs show normal ListRecommendations operations. This indicates the service was intentionally or accidentally scaled to zero, creating an availability gap without any underlying application or resource issues.
